description: Isi Sendiri is a team of five Computer Science undergraduate students from Indonesia building an interactive web and AI-driven solution powered by NASA open data for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge.
summary: TerraShift AI is an aerospace-grade agro-physical decision-support terminal that empowers farmers to adapt to shifting temperatures, erratic rainfall, and soil nitrogen collapse. By coupling live 9-parameter telemetry from the NASA POWER Agroclimatology API, SMAP root-zone wetness, and MODIS GIBS satellite imagery with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith thermodynamics, 1D Richards PDE soil hydrology, and an 8³=512 combinatorial Pareto optimizer, TerraShift AI prescribes 3-season crop rotations (such as SOY-RIC-MNG) that eliminate pathogen carryover, conserve +429 mm/yr of irrigation water, and save 137 kg/ha of synthetic Urea fertilizer via biological nitrogen fixation.
details:
1. WHAT IT DOES

TerraShift AI bridges the gap between orbital Earth observation telemetry and village-level planting decisions. Farmers and agricultural extension officers can select calibrated Indonesian pedology sectors (Banyumas/Purwokerto, Aceh Besar, and Subang) or click any global coordinate on our Orbital Targeting GIS map to generate a mathematically optimal 3-season crop rotation schedule (Wet Onset -> Transition -> Dry Peak).

2. HOW IT WORKS (FIRST-PRINCIPLES AGRO-PHYSICS & COMPUTER SCIENCE)

- FAO-56 Penman-Monteith Thermodynamics: Streams 9 parameters from the NASA POWER API (T2M, T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN, PRECTOTCORR, GWETROOT, ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN, RH2M, WS2M, PS) to compute saturation vapor pressure (es), Vapor Pressure Deficit (VPD = 0.629 kPa), curve slope (Delta = 0.2019), and reference evapotranspiration (ET0 = 3.43 mm/d).

- 3D Finite-Volume Voxel Stratigraphy & 1D Richards PDE Hovmoller Diagram: Simulates 365-day vertical soil moisture propagation theta(z,t) and nitrate plumes NO3-(z,t) across 10 soil depth horizons (0-100cm) coupled with SCS Curve Number surface runoff and Beer-Lambert canopy PAR interception (fIPAR = 1 - exp(-k * LAI)).

- Combinatorial 8^3 = 512 State-Space Pareto Optimizer & Markov Phytopathology Matrix: Evaluates all 512 3-season permutations across 8 tropical genotypes in 0.4ms, penalizing consecutive same-family monoculture to break soil-borne pathogen cycles (0% Pathogen Penalty) and computing N=400 Box-Muller Monte Carlo stochastic confidence bands (P10-P90).

- Bilingual AI Agronomist & Built-In Dossier Export: Generates actionable prescriptions in English and Bahasa Indonesia alongside CSV telemetry export and printable PDF farm reports.

3. BENEFITS & MEASURABLE IMPACT (PURWOKERTO BENCHMARK: SOY-RIC-MNG)

- Hydrological Conservation: Saves +429 mm/yr (+4,290 m3/ha) of irrigation water compared to continuous rice monoculture.

- Fertilizer & Soil Recovery: Restores +18 kg N/ha net soil nitrogen pool via Bradyrhizobium symbiosis, replacing 137 kg/ha of synthetic Urea fertilizer.

- Economic & Carbon Co-Benefits: Generates $9,943/ha gross revenue across 3 seasons while sequestering +3.81 tCO2e/ha/yr.

4. TOOLS & TECHNOLOGY USED

React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, HTML5 3D Isometric Voxel Canvas Engine, Leaflet GIS, Esri World Imagery, NASA POWER REST API, and NASA Earthdata GIBS WMTS. Source Code Repository: https://github.com/Asyraff-1/terrashift-ai
